correctness.rationale: For three equally weighted real ℓ1 sites the separable objective is minimized uniquely by each coordinate's middle value, including ties. Let a be the sum of coordinatewise minima of the two absolute values. Same-sign coordinates contribute that minimum to ‖m‖1, while opposite-sign coordinates contribute zero. In either sign pattern |m_i−(x_i+y_i)/2|=||x_i|−|y_i||/2, so the distance to the midpoint is 1−a and the distance to the origin is at most a. This proves the upper bound without orthogonality. Equality requires a=‖m‖1=1/2, excludes nonzero opposite-sign overlap, and makes the origin a nearest point in the hull. The one-sided derivative of the distance along tx at 0 is 1−2 times the mass of x on the support of m, where this expression means 1−2·∑_{i:m_i≠0}|x_i|. Its nonnegativity, and the analogous fact for y, force both masses to equal the overlap mass 1/2. Equality of each sum with the sum of pointwise minima forces x=y wherever both are nonzero. The remaining supports are disjoint, yielding the three half-mass pieces. Conversely the distance to every hull point is exactly 1/2 by disjoint-support additivity. On the common and x-only supports a norm-one dual functional with the coordinate signs, and with opposite signs on the y-only support, attains 1 at x and vanishes at y, certifying x⊥_B y. Swapping the exclusive pieces proves the converse orthogonality. The explicit 3-coordinate example attains the bound, and in dimension three the three nonzero disjoint pieces must occupy one coordinate each, giving exactly the stated signed-permutation class.
residual_risks: The rational diagnostic is not exhaustive over real pairs; the result is supported by the exact proof. No extension to complex spaces, dimensions below three for sharpness, unequal norms, or near-equality is certified.

value.rationale: The endpoint estimate is elementary, but the result quantifies a canonical failure of the convex-hull criterion and determines every sharp configuration across dimensions. It also shows that adding the one-sided orthogonality hypothesis does not lower the optimum, for the substantive reason that every unrestricted extremizer is already mutually orthogonal, and singles out the unique dimension-three configuration up to the listed symmetries.
residual_risks: This is a sharp normalized model result, not a characterization or stability estimate for general normed spaces.
